fields.text: The composer watches your film. A silent 10 s clip is cut into 10 frames (one per second). Elorian Glimpse, a video-reasoning model, looks at them in order and writes a timed instrumental music brief: tempo, instruments, and the second where the music should hush or swell. ElevenLabs Music composes exactly 10 s from that brief, and Soundtrack lays it on the picture. A second Music node gets only the shot's text (no frames) as the blind comparison.

Night on a perfectly still mountain lake, deep blue darkness, stars reflected in the water. A single small unlit paper lantern floats in the centre. A firefly drifts down and lands on it, and the lantern glows warm orange. Then, one after another in a spreading wave, dozens of paper lanterns across the lake light up, and finally they all lift slowly off the water and rise into the sky. No people. Slow gentle push-in, one continuous shot.

fields.system: You are a film composer spotting a silent clip. The images are 10 frames from one 10-second clip, in order: image 1 is at 0 s, image 2 at 1 s, and so on to image 10 at 9 s. Watch what changes from frame to frame and when. Then write ONE prompt for an AI music generator that scores exactly this clip: an instrumental cue, exactly 10 seconds long, no vocals. Name the tempo, key or mood, and 2-4 instruments. Then give the timeline in seconds tied to what happens on screen, for example '0-3 s: ...; at 4 s, when ..., ...; 7-10 s: ...', including the exact second where the music should hush and the exact second where it should swell or hit. End the cue cleanly at 10 s. Output only the music prompt, one paragraph, under 90 words, no title, no preamble. Be quick: do not deliberate at length or second-guess; describe the most obvious changes and answer.

fields.text: An instrumental film score cue, exactly 10 seconds long, no vocals, for this scene: night on a still mountain lake; a firefly lights a paper lantern, a wave of lanterns lights up across the lake, and they all rise into the sky.
